==Dialogue==
'''To mesmers:'''
:''"Welcome to the monastery, fellow Mesmer. I trust you have met [[Headmaster Kaa]]. Do not be put off by him. He is a powerful man and is often misunderstood. It would be wise to learn all you can from him in your time here. Now, what brings you to my post?"''

'''To non-mesmers:'''
:''"A shame you are not a Mesmer, so you will not have the opportunity to train with Headmaster Kaa. He is wise beyond his years and more powerful than most people realize."''

;Monastery Overlook
:''"Now is not the time to talk. Please concentrate on your studies."''

'''In'' Divine Path:'' '''
:''"[[Lo Sha]] and I are to be married!."''

==Trivia==
*Mei Ling is the name of the female lead character in Bruce Lee's [[w:Enter the Dragon|Enter the Dragon]].
